note: Achievement definitions are server-side and fetched via API. This file documents the client-side system architecture, known achievement types, data structures, and the certificate system.

fetchAchievements.description: Fetch individual achievements for a company. Returns achievement objects with progress, rewards, and collection status.

fetchAchievementsOverview.description: Fetch achievement overviews (summary with stars, labels, images). Used on the Achievements page.

collectAchievement.description: Collect an achievement reward. Removes the achievement from the pending list.

applyLevelBonus.description: Apply a level-based achievement bonus. Specialization is either 'production' (1% production speed) or 'sales' (1% sales speed). Available every 5 levels.

sync3rdParty.description: Sync achievements to Steam (3rd party platform). Returns tasks array with status per achievement.

individualAchievement.description: An achievement that can be collected for rewards. Returned by fetchAchievements.

id.description: Unique achievement identifier (used in API URLs)

is_daily.description: True for daily-reset achievements (Logged in, Produced/Sold)

is_level.description: True for level-based achievements that grant recurring bonuses

level.description: Current level number (for level-based achievements). Every 5th level offers a specialization bonus choice.

done.description: Number of times completed/quality stars earned

nextAchievement.description: Preview of the next tier. Contains: name, done, available, message, reward, sim_boosts

achievementOverview.description: Summary view of an achievement category. Returned by fetchAchievementsOverview.

label.description: Display label in the Achievements page

type.description: Achievement type key (e.g., Builder, Employer). Used for hint targeting.

id.description: Achievement identifier for 'put on display' functionality

rewards.description: Array of cash rewards for each tier

knownAchievementTypes.description: Achievement types discovered from client-side hints, changelogs, and onboarding data. The 'type' field in achievementOverview maps to these keys.

MarketBuyer.hintCategory: Early game achievements - purchasing from exchange

Enable Scientist achievements at the right realm phase

KnowItAll.description: Based on producing different resource types

changelogRefs: Over-achiever achievement for top 6,000 rank added (Dec 7)
Overachiever top achievement adjusted - Rank 50 needed, was 30

Mentor.description: Likely related to executive training or referrals

Supplier.description: Based on supplying resources to the exchange

Prospector.description: Likely related to resource gathering or mining

changelogRefs: Added progress bar to the GO Bureaucrat achievement to show progress towards fulfilling government orders
Improve architect achievement detection to make sure player receives it
Architect.description: Based on building or construction activities

achievements.name: Logged in today
achievements.trigger: Logging into the game each day
achievements.changelogRef: More timely delivery of the daily achievements: logged-in and production/retail start (Jun 1)

achievements.name: Produced or sold today
achievements.trigger: Starting production or making a retail sale
achievements.changelogRef: More timely delivery of the daily achievements: logged-in and production/retail start (Jun 1)

mechanics.localStorage: daily-achievements-{companyId} tracks collection status with value 'collected'
mechanics.cacheExpiry: Achievements refetched after 4 minutes if daily not yet collected

levelBasedAchievements.description: Achievements with is_level=true. They have levels that increment. Every 5 levels, the player can choose a specialization bonus: +1% production speed or +1% sales speed.
levelBasedAchievements.steamTracking: Level-based achievement collection triggers Cde() for Steam tracking with source, country, companyId, realmId, level, and email.

achievementRewards.cash: Achievements award cash (reward field). Cash is animated flying from achievement position to company money display.
achievementRewards.simBoosts: Achievements award SimBoosts (sim_boosts field). Animated similarly to cash rewards.
achievementRewards.display: Achievements can be displayed in the company display case alongside certificates and resources.
achievementRewards.ocdCertificate: A special 'allAchievements' certificate is awarded for achieving all available achievements (OCD certified).

achievementProgress.description: Achievements track progress using done/available counters or progress.percent.
achievementProgress.starSystem: Overview achievements use stars/starsMax to show tier completion. Stars = starsMax means fully completed.
achievementProgress.qualityDisplay: Individual achievements show done/(done+available) as quality stars.

mechanism.trigger: Automatic on achievements page load, or triggered by collectAchievement when running on Steam (Et.callIfSteam).
mechanism.throttle: Maximum once per 12 hours (43200000ms). Tracked via localStorage keys.
mechanism.manualTrigger: User can click 'Sync achievements' button in the display case / company profile (Account page).

history.initialIntegration: Achievements integration with steam achievements (part 1 - proof of concept, 2 achievements added)
fixes: Fix achievement syncing to steam achievements

certificates.description: Certificates are monthly/weekly awards displayed in company profiles. They are separate from achievements but can be showcased in the display case alongside achievements.

allAchievements.description: Awarded for achieving all available achievements (OCD certified).

producerCertificate.description: The Producer certificate can be obtained by producing most units of a specific non-research resource in a month.

fastestValue.description: Awarded to the fastest growing company by value in a week/month.

fastestBuilding.description: Awarded to the fastest growing company by building value in a week/month.

fastestEmployer.description: Awarded to the fastest growing employer in a week/month.

largestValue.description: Awarded to the largest company by value in a month.

largestBuilding.description: Awarded to the largest company by building value in a month.

largestEmployer.description: Awarded to the largest employer in a month.

largestSeller.description: Awarded to the company earning most money in a month by selling resources on the exchange.

largestBuyer.description: Awarded to the company spending most money buying resources on the exchange in a month.

highestPatents.description: Awarded to the company with the highest patents value in a month.

veteran.description: Awarded to companies that have been playing for {years} year(s).

highestShare.description: Awarded to the company with the highest share price.

supporter.description: Awarded to companies for supporting the game by purchasing the supporter package.

kingMidas.description: Awarded to the company with the most golden bars in a month.

startOver.description: Awarded to companies that did a start-over reset.

elonAward.description: Awarded to the company with the most rapid unscheduled disassemblies (rocket explosions on launch) in a month.

educator.description: Awarded to the company that did most executive trainings in a month.

loanShark.description: Awarded to the company that collected the most bond interest in a month.

retailer.description: Awarded to the company that sold the most of a specific resource in retail in a month.

madScientist.description: Awarded to the company that produced most research units of a specific research in a month.

simichelineStar.description: Awarded to the company with the best rated restaurant in a month.

largestResetValue.description: Awarded to the largest company which did a reset in a specific year, by value in a month.

cashCow.description: Awarded to the company that paid the most taxes in a month.

realEstateMogul.description: Awarded to the company that sold the most buildings in the Building Auction in a month.

executivePimp.description: Awarded to the company that earned the most royalties in a month.

cyberSpire.description: Awarded for supporting the game by purchasing the Cyber Spire HQ.

obsidian.description: Awarded for supporting the game by purchasing the Obsidian HQ.

cyberTower.description: Awarded for supporting the game by purchasing the Cyber Tower HQ.

overfeeder.description: Awarded to the restaurant that fed the most people in a month.

dumpsterChef.description: Awarded to the restaurant that wasted the most food, by resource value, in a month.

walletWielder.description: Awarded to the company that bought buildings with the highest total book value in the Building Auction in a month.

contest.description: Awarded to the company which successfully participated in a contest.

eggCollector.description: Awarded to the company that cracked the competition and egg-quired the most Eggs by the Easter season's end.

displayCase.description: Companies can showcase achievements, certificates, resources, and collectibles in their display case. Each item takes one slot.
displayCase.maxSlots: Maximum display case slots: 12 (increased from 8, Nov 2 changelog)
displayCase.slotUnlock: Additional slots can be unlocked using SimBoosts via PATCH /api/v2/companies/me/display-case/
displayCase.achievementDisplay: Achievements in display case show: name, achievement icon image, and quality stars.
displayCase.revenueStream: Achievement rewards + SimBoost exchanges contribute to 'From Game' income on financial statements.

actions.UPDATE_ACHIEVEMENTS: Replaces achievements array, sets timestamp, fetchingAchievements=false
actions.REMOVE_ACHIEVEMENT: Removes achievement by id from array
